sloka: बुभुक्षितः शोणितमांसगृध्नुः प्रविश्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम्।चखाद रक्षांसि हरीन् पिशाचानृक्षांश्च मोहाद्युधि कुम्भकर्णः ।। ६.६७.९५ ।।
transliteration: bubhukṣitaḥ śoṇitamāṁsagṛdhnuḥ praviśya tadvānarasainyamugram।cakhāda rakṣāṁsi harīn piśācānṛkṣāṁśca mohādyudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ ।। 6.67.95 ।।

translations.english: The great Kumbhakarna then departing instantly entered into Vanara army consumed them as fire at dissolution consumed people.
